description: This file is a script for checking web search provider boundary inventory within a codebase. It parses project files to identify imports and registrations of web search providers, generating a boundary inventory report for testing and validation purposes.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Asynchronously scans project files to collect web search provider boundary entries based on imports and plugin IDs.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline JSON inventory file for comparison in tests.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the inventory collection and comparison, typically used in test scripts.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script, runs the boundary check and exits with appropriate code.
